map.输入光照强度(PPFD)与每日补光时长，计算每日光积分DLI(mol/m²/d): Enter light intensity (PPFD) and daily supplemental lighting hours to compute the Daily Light Integral DLI (mol/m²/d), compare against crop photosynthetic demand to assess whether greenhouses need supplemental lighting and at what intensity, guiding supplemental light operation strategy.
map.DLI = PPFD(μmol/m²/s) × 光照时长(h) × 3600 ÷: DLI = PPFD(μmol/m²/s) × lighting hours (h) × 3600 ÷ 1 000 000 (mol/m²/d); total DLI = natural DLI + supplemental DLI
map.每日光积分（DLI）为光照强度对时间的积分：PPFD 乘光照秒数再除以 1 00: Daily Light Integral (DLI) is the integral of light intensity over time: PPFD times lighting seconds divided by 1 000 000 to convert to mol/m²/d. Compute natural light and supplemental light separately, add them for the total DLI, then compare with the crop's target range: ≥ upper limit means ample light, ≥ lower limit means adequate, ≥ 70% of the lower limit means somewhat weak, otherwise severely insufficient. The shortfall can be back-calculated into required supplemental hours or intensity.

map.DLI 不够一定要补光吗？: Must supplemental lighting be added when DLI falls short?
map.看作物与季节。耐弱光叶菜影响小，果菜类徒长、花芽分化差则必须补。先算自然 DLI: It depends on the crop and season. Shade-tolerant leafy vegetables are barely affected, but fruit vegetables that sprawl or differentiate flower buds poorly must be supplemented. Compute natural DLI first, then decide, to avoid wasted power.
map.多数植物需要暗期完成生理节律，连续光照未必增产反而耗能。按作物光周期（长日/短日: Most plants need a dark period to complete their physiological rhythm; continuous lighting does not necessarily raise yield and wastes power. Designing the light/dark ratio by crop photoperiod (long-day / short-day) is more scientific.
